questions.questionEn: According to the BC Patient Assessment Model, which component must be completed first on every call?
questions.questionZh: 根据 BC 患者评估模型，每次出勤必须最先完成哪个组成部分？

options.en: Primary survey
options.zh: 初步检查（Primary Survey）

options.en: Secondary survey
options.zh: 再次检查（Secondary Survey）

options.en: Rescue scene evaluation
options.zh: 救援现场评估（Rescue Scene Evaluation）

options.en: Obtaining the critical history
options.zh: 获取关键病史

questions.explanationEn: The Patient Assessment Model sequence begins with the Rescue Scene Evaluation, followed by the primary survey, secondary survey, protocols, treatments, load and transport, and records and reports.
questions.explanationZh: 患者评估模型的顺序以救援现场评估开始，之后依次是初步检查、再次检查、协议、治疗、装载转运以及记录与报告。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is one of the listed steps of the Rescue Scene Evaluation?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪一项是救援现场评估（RSE）所列的步骤之一？

options.en: Forming a general impression of the patient
options.zh: 对患者形成总体印象（General Impression）

options.en: Head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 从头到脚检查

options.en: Obtaining baseline vital signs
options.zh: 测量基线生命体征

options.en: Functional inquiry
options.zh: 系统功能问诊（Functional Inquiry）

questions.explanationEn: The RSE steps are: hazards, environment, mechanism of injury, people, additional resources, and general impression. Vitals and head-to-toe belong to the secondary survey.
questions.explanationZh: RSE 的步骤为：危险因素、环境、受伤机制、人员、额外资源和总体印象。生命体征与从头到脚检查属于再次检查。

questions.questionEn: You arrive at a single-vehicle crash. A power line is draped across the car and the conscious driver is calling for help. What should you do first?
questions.questionZh: 你到达一起单车事故现场，一条电线搭在车上，清醒的司机正在呼救。你应该首先做什么？

options.en: Approach the car and begin the primary survey through the window
options.zh: 靠近车辆，通过车窗开始初步检查

options.en: Move the power line aside with a wooden pole so you can reach the driver
options.zh: 用木杆将电线拨开以便接近司机

options.en: Ask the driver to climb out and walk to you immediately
options.zh: 让司机立即自行爬出并走向你

options.en: Stay clear, keep bystanders back, and request the appropriate additional resources before approaching
options.zh: 保持距离，让围观者退后，在接近前请求相应的额外资源

questions.explanationEn: The purpose of the Rescue Scene Evaluation is to ensure the scene is safe for the crew and patient. An energized line is an uncontrolled hazard; identify hazards and call for additional resources before patient contact.
questions.explanationZh: 救援现场评估的目的在于确保现场对救护人员和患者安全。带电电线是未控制的危险源，接触患者前必须先识别危险并请求额外资源。

questions.questionEn: What is the stated purpose of the primary survey?
questions.questionZh: 初步检查（Primary Survey）的既定目的是什么？

options.en: To establish the patient's chief complaint and baseline vital signs
options.zh: 确定患者主诉并建立基线生命体征

options.en: To identify and manage life- and limb-threatening injuries and conditions
options.zh: 识别并处理危及生命和肢体的损伤与病情

options.en: To gather information about the mechanism of injury
options.zh: 收集受伤机制的相关信息

options.en: To document assessment findings for the receiving hospital
options.zh: 为接收医院记录评估结果

questions.explanationEn: Per the model, the primary survey exists to identify and manage life- and limb-threatening injuries and conditions; the chief complaint and baseline vitals belong to the secondary survey.
questions.explanationZh: 依据评估模型，初步检查的目的是识别并处理危及生命和肢体的损伤与病情；主诉与基线生命体征属于再次检查的内容。

questions.questionEn: You have assessed LOC and applied spinal precautions on a trauma patient. According to the primary survey sequence, what do you assess next?
questions.questionZh: 你已评估了创伤患者的意识水平并采取了脊柱保护措施。按照初步检查顺序，接下来应评估什么？

options.en: Circulation
options.zh: 循环

options.en: Airway
options.zh: 气道

options.en: Rapid body survey
options.zh: 快速全身检查

options.en: Pupillary response
options.zh: 瞳孔反应

questions.explanationEn: The primary survey steps are: LOC, spinal precautions, airway, breathing, circulation, rapid body survey, survey interventions, and the transport decision.
questions.explanationZh: 初步检查的步骤为：意识水平、脊柱保护、气道、呼吸、循环、快速全身检查、检查干预措施及转运决定。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is NOT one of the survey interventions performed during the primary survey?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项不属于初步检查中的检查干预措施（survey interventions）？

options.en: Administering oxygen
options.zh: 给予氧气

options.en: Bandaging a major hemorrhage
options.zh: 包扎大出血

options.en: Applying a pelvic binder
options.zh: 使用骨盆固定带

options.en: Obtaining a detailed medication history
options.zh: 获取详细的用药史

questions.explanationEn: Primary survey interventions are skin, oxygen, airway, position, bandage, pelvic binder, and blanket (warmth). Detailed history-taking belongs to the secondary survey.
questions.explanationZh: 初步检查的干预措施包括皮肤、氧气、气道、体位、包扎、骨盆固定带和毛毯保暖。详细病史采集属于再次检查。

questions.questionEn: You have just completed the rapid body survey on a trauma patient and found an oozing scalp wound and cool skin. According to the primary survey sequence, what should you do next?
questions.questionZh: 你刚完成一名创伤患者的快速全身检查，发现头皮伤口渗血、皮肤发凉。按照初步检查顺序，接下来应该做什么？

options.en: Carry out the survey interventions (skin, oxygen, airway, position, bandage, pelvic binder, blanket)
options.zh: 执行检查干预措施（皮肤、氧气、气道、体位、包扎、骨盆固定带、毛毯）

options.en: Begin the head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 开始从头到脚检查

options.en: Obtain a SAMPLE history from bystanders
options.zh: 向旁观者采集 SAMPLE 病史

options.en: Complete the patient care report
options.zh: 完成患者护理报告

questions.explanationEn: After the rapid body survey, the primary survey continues with the survey interventions and then the transport decision. The head-to-toe and history are secondary survey elements.
questions.explanationZh: 快速全身检查之后，初步检查继续进行检查干预措施，然后做出转运决定。从头到脚检查和病史属于再次检查。

questions.questionEn: Which element of the secondary survey is required for PCP candidates but not for EMR candidates?
questions.questionZh: 再次检查中的哪个组成部分是 PCP 考生必须完成而 EMR 考生不要求的？

options.en: History
options.zh: 病史

options.en: Vital signs
options.zh: 生命体征

options.en: Functional inquiry
options.zh: 系统功能问诊（Functional Inquiry）

options.en: Head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 从头到脚检查

questions.explanationEn: The secondary survey consists of history, vital signs, and head-to-toe examination; the functional inquiry is listed as PCP required.
questions.explanationZh: 再次检查包括病史、生命体征和从头到脚检查；系统功能问诊被标注为 PCP 必做项目。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old woman fell down several stairs. She is alert, but her skin is cool, pale, and clammy. How should you categorize this patient?
questions.questionZh: 一名 78 岁女性从数级楼梯上摔下。她神志清醒，但皮肤发凉、苍白、湿冷。你应如何归类该患者？

options.en: Unstable — cool, pale, clammy skin suggests shock and requires appropriate transport
options.zh: 不稳定——皮肤凉、苍白、湿冷提示休克，需按不稳定患者转运

options.en: Stable — she is alert and answering questions
options.zh: 稳定——她清醒且能回答问题

options.en: Stable — skin findings alone never change patient status
options.zh: 稳定——仅凭皮肤表现不会改变患者状态

options.en: Unstable only if her radial pulse is also absent
options.zh: 只有当桡动脉搏动同时消失时才算不稳定

questions.explanationEn: Cool, pale, clammy skin secondary to suspected shock is a primary survey finding that makes an adult patient unstable, regardless of mental status.
questions.explanationZh: 疑似休克导致的皮肤凉、苍白、湿冷是初步检查中判定成人患者不稳定的表现之一，与神志是否清醒无关。

questions.questionEn: A 9-year-old struck by a car has a strong carotid pulse but you cannot feel radial pulses in either wrist. How does this finding affect patient status?
questions.questionZh: 一名被汽车撞伤的 9 岁儿童颈动脉搏动有力，但双侧桡动脉均触不到。该发现如何影响患者状态判定？

options.en: It is normal in children and can be ignored
options.zh: 这在儿童中属正常，可以忽略

options.en: It only matters if the child is also unconscious
options.zh: 只有当患儿同时昏迷时才有意义

options.en: Absent radial pulses is a primary survey finding that makes the patient unstable
options.zh: 桡动脉搏动消失是初步检查中判定患者不稳定的表现

options.en: Recheck in 15 minutes before deciding
options.zh: 15 分钟后复查再作决定

questions.explanationEn: Absent radial pulses appears on the list of primary survey findings that categorize a patient as unstable and requiring appropriate transport.
questions.explanationZh: 桡动脉搏动消失属于初步检查不稳定表现清单中的一项，此类患者应按不稳定处理并及时转运。

questions.questionEn: Which fall mechanism meets the mechanism-of-injury criterion for an unstable patient?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪种坠落机制符合判定患者不稳定的受伤机制标准？

options.en: Fall from a 1-metre bed onto carpet
options.zh: 从 1 米高的床上跌落到地毯上

options.en: Free fall from a height of 7 metres
options.zh: 从 7 米高处自由坠落

options.en: Tripping over a curb at walking speed
options.zh: 步行时被路缘绊倒

options.en: Fall from a 2-metre step ladder onto grass
options.zh: 从 2 米高的梯凳跌落到草地上

questions.explanationEn: A free fall from a height greater than 6 metres (about 20 feet) is a listed mechanism-of-injury criterion for instability.
questions.explanationZh: 从超过 6 米（约 20 英尺）高处自由坠落是判定不稳定的受伤机制标准之一。

questions.questionEn: A cyclist was struck by a car. Bystanders report the car was travelling at approximately which speed for the mechanism alone to categorize the cyclist as unstable?
questions.questionZh: 一名骑自行车者被汽车撞倒。仅凭受伤机制即可将其判定为不稳定时，旁观者报告的车速大约应是多少？

options.en: 15 km/h
options.zh: 15 公里/小时

options.en: 20 km/h
options.zh: 20 公里/小时

options.en: 25 km/h
options.zh: 25 公里/小时

options.en: 40 km/h
options.zh: 40 公里/小时

questions.explanationEn: Auto versus pedestrian or cyclist at greater than 30 km/h is a high-risk mechanism; 40 km/h exceeds that threshold while the other listed speeds do not.
questions.explanationZh: 汽车撞击行人或骑车者速度大于 30 公里/小时属高危机制；40 公里/小时超过该阈值，其余选项均未超过。

questions.questionEn: Which degree of passenger-compartment intrusion makes a motor vehicle crash a high-risk mechanism?
questions.questionZh: 车厢侵入达到何种程度时，机动车碰撞被视为高危机制？

options.en: 10 cm of intrusion on the side opposite the occupant
options.zh: 乘员对侧侵入 10 厘米

options.en: 15 cm of intrusion on the occupant side
options.zh: 乘员一侧侵入 15 厘米

options.en: 20 cm of roof deformation
options.zh: 车顶变形 20 厘米

options.en: 35 cm of intrusion on the occupant side
options.zh: 乘员一侧侵入 35 厘米

questions.explanationEn: Significant intrusion is defined as more than 0.3 m on the occupant side or more than 0.5 m at any site including the roof; 35 cm on the occupant side exceeds the 0.3 m threshold.
questions.explanationZh: 显著侵入定义为乘员一侧超过 0.3 米，或包括车顶在内的任何部位超过 0.5 米；乘员侧 35 厘米已超过 0.3 米的标准。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old skier crashed into a tree. Which anatomical finding would categorize him as unstable?
questions.questionZh: 一名 30 岁滑雪者撞上树木。下列哪项解剖学发现会将其判定为不稳定？

options.en: A closed, non-deformed forearm fracture
options.zh: 闭合且无畸形的前臂骨折

options.en: Suspected fractures of both femurs
options.zh: 疑似双侧股骨骨折

options.en: An isolated clavicle fracture
options.zh: 单纯锁骨骨折

options.en: A sprained ankle with intact pulses
options.zh: 踝关节扭伤且脉搏正常

questions.explanationEn: Two or more proximal long bone fractures is a listed anatomical finding of instability; the femur is a proximal long bone.
questions.explanationZh: 两处及以上近端长骨骨折是判定不稳定的解剖学表现之一；股骨属于近端长骨。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old man was burned in a kitchen fire. Which burn pattern makes him unstable?
questions.questionZh: 一名 70 岁男性在厨房火灾中烧伤。下列哪种烧伤情况会使其被判定为不稳定？

options.en: Partial thickness burns to 10% of his body surface area
options.zh: 占体表面积 10% 的部分皮层烧伤

options.en: Superficial redness over one forearm
options.zh: 一侧前臂的表皮发红

options.en: Partial thickness burns to 25% of his body surface area
options.zh: 占体表面积 25% 的部分皮层烧伤

options.en: A 2% full thickness burn on the calf
options.zh: 小腿 2% 的全皮层烧伤

questions.explanationEn: Major burns causing instability include partial thickness burns over 20% BSA or full thickness burns over 10% BSA; 25% partial thickness exceeds the threshold.
questions.explanationZh: 判定不稳定的重度烧伤包括部分皮层烧伤超过体表面积 20% 或全皮层烧伤超过 10%；25% 的部分皮层烧伤已超标。

questions.questionEn: A grossly deformed lower leg has no pedal pulse. After one attempt at re-alignment the pulse does not return. What is the patient's status?
questions.questionZh: 一条严重畸形的小腿摸不到足背动脉搏动。一次复位尝试后脉搏仍未恢复。该患者的状态是什么？

options.en: Unstable — a pulseless extremity after one failed re-alignment attempt
options.zh: 不稳定——一次复位失败后肢体仍无脉搏

options.en: Stable — limb injuries never affect patient status
options.zh: 稳定——肢体损伤不影响患者状态

options.en: Stable if the patient has no pain
options.zh: 若患者无疼痛则为稳定

options.en: Undetermined until vital signs are taken
options.zh: 在测量生命体征前无法判定

questions.explanationEn: A pulseless extremity after one failed attempt at re-alignment is a listed anatomical finding of instability; only one re-alignment attempt is permitted.
questions.explanationZh: 一次复位尝试失败后肢体仍无脉搏是判定不稳定的解剖学表现；复位只允许尝试一次。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old man is found unconscious at the bottom of a staircase. No one saw what happened. Regarding cervical spine care, you should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 79 岁男性被发现昏迷倒在楼梯底部，无人目击经过。关于颈椎处理，你应该：

options.en: Omit spinal precautions because there is no visible injury
options.zh: 因无可见外伤而不采取脊柱保护

options.en: Wait for a witness to confirm a fall before stabilizing
options.zh: 等目击者证实跌倒后再固定

options.en: Stabilize the cervical spine because he is unconscious and trauma cannot reasonably be ruled out
options.zh: 因其昏迷且无法合理排除创伤，应固定颈椎

options.en: Place him in the recovery position first, then consider the spine
options.zh: 先置于复原体位，再考虑脊柱问题

questions.explanationEn: Cervical spine stabilization is indicated for an unconscious patient where trauma cannot be reasonably ruled out.
questions.explanationZh: 对于无法合理排除创伤的昏迷患者，颈椎固定是初步检查干预的适应证。

questions.questionEn: Which finding is a listed indication for cervical spine stabilization in the primary survey?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项发现是初步检查中颈椎固定的适应证？

options.en: An obvious injury above the level of the clavicles
options.zh: 锁骨水平以上的明显损伤

options.en: Any patient complaining of a headache
options.zh: 任何主诉头痛的患者

options.en: Isolated abrasions to the knees
options.zh: 单纯的膝部擦伤

options.en: A history of chronic back pain
options.zh: 慢性背痛病史

questions.explanationEn: Indications for cervical spine stabilization are NEXUS or Canadian C-Spine criteria, obvious injury above the clavicles, and an unconscious patient where trauma cannot be ruled out.
questions.explanationZh: 颈椎固定的适应证包括符合 NEXUS 或加拿大颈椎标准、锁骨水平以上的明显损伤，以及无法排除创伤的昏迷患者。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old was struck by a car travelling about 35 km/h. She is alert with only abrasions visible. How should you manage her?
questions.questionZh: 一名 6 岁女孩被时速约 35 公里的汽车撞倒。她神志清醒，仅见擦伤。你应如何处置？

options.en: Release her to her parents since she looks well
options.zh: 因她看起来无碍，交由父母照看

options.en: Treat as stable and complete a full assessment on scene at leisure
options.zh: 按稳定处理，在现场从容完成全部评估

options.en: Only transport if she develops pain
options.zh: 仅在出现疼痛时才转运

options.en: Treat as unstable based on the mechanism of injury and transport appropriately
options.zh: 基于受伤机制按不稳定处理并及时转运

questions.explanationEn: Auto versus pedestrian at greater than 30 km/h is a high-risk mechanism; such patients are considered unstable regardless of how well they initially appear.
questions.explanationZh: 车速超过 30 公里/小时的汽车撞击行人属高危机制；无论初始外观如何，该类患者应按不稳定处理。

questions.questionEn: You are assessing an 81-year-old who tripped at home. At what point in the assessment model is the transport decision made?
questions.questionZh: 你正在评估一名在家中绊倒的 81 岁患者。在评估模型中，转运决定应在哪个环节做出？

options.en: Before making patient contact
options.zh: 接触患者之前

options.en: At the end of the primary survey
options.zh: 初步检查结束时

options.en: Only after the head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 必须在从头到脚检查之后

options.en: After all protocols have been completed
options.zh: 所有协议执行完毕之后

questions.explanationEn: The transport decision is the final step of the primary survey, made once life- and limb-threats have been identified and managed.
questions.explanationZh: 转运决定是初步检查的最后一步，在识别并处理危及生命和肢体的问题后做出。

questions.questionEn: A restrained 5-year-old in a moderate-speed collision is alert with normal breathing and pink skin. Which primary survey intervention is still indicated?
questions.questionZh: 一名系好安全带的 5 岁儿童经历中速碰撞，神志清醒、呼吸正常、皮肤红润。哪项初步检查干预仍然有指征？

options.en: No interventions are needed for an alert child
options.zh: 清醒的儿童不需要任何干预

options.en: Supplemental oxygen, because trauma is a listed indication
options.zh: 给予氧气，因为创伤是给氧的适应证之一

options.en: Oral glucose to prevent hypoglycemia
options.zh: 口服葡萄糖以预防低血糖

options.en: Entonox for comfort
options.zh: 给予安桃乐（Entonox）以缓解不适

questions.explanationEn: Oxygen is indicated in the primary survey for altered LOC, respiratory distress, trauma, evidence of shock, and hypoxia NYD. Trauma alone is an indication.
questions.explanationZh: 初步检查中给氧的适应证包括意识改变、呼吸窘迫、创伤、休克表现及原因未明的低氧。单是创伤本身即为给氧指征。

questions.questionEn: A motorcyclist who crashed at highway speed has an unstable pelvis on the rapid body survey and cool, pale skin. When should the pelvis be bound?
questions.questionZh: 一名高速摔车的摩托车手在快速全身检查中发现骨盆不稳定，皮肤凉而苍白。应在何时进行骨盆捆绑？

options.en: After the head-to-toe examination in the secondary survey
options.zh: 在再次检查的从头到脚检查之后

options.en: Only after arrival at the hospital
options.zh: 到达医院后才进行

options.en: Only if the blood pressure drops below 90 mmHg
options.zh: 仅当血压低于 90 mmHg 时

options.en: During the primary survey, as a survey intervention
options.zh: 在初步检查期间作为检查干预措施执行

questions.explanationEn: Pelvic binding is a primary survey intervention indicated for a suspected fracture due to mechanism or an unstable pelvis, including shock-like symptoms with MOI.
questions.explanationZh: 骨盆捆绑是初步检查干预措施，适应证为受伤机制怀疑骨折或骨盆不稳定，包括伴有休克样表现的受伤机制。

questions.questionEn: You have just loaded a 76-year-old trauma patient's stretcher into the ambulance. According to the load and transport component, what should you do immediately after this major move?
questions.questionZh: 你刚将一名 76 岁创伤患者的担架装入救护车。根据装载与转运环节的要求，这次大的移动之后应立即做什么？

options.en: Reassess the ABCs and injuries (ABCI)
options.zh: 重新评估 ABC 和损伤情况（ABCI）

options.en: Complete the patient care report before departing
options.zh: 出发前先完成患者护理报告

options.en: Remove spinal precautions now that the patient is secured
options.zh: 患者已固定好，可解除脊柱保护

options.en: Turn off monitoring equipment to save power
options.zh: 关闭监护设备以省电

questions.explanationEn: The load and transport component requires reassessing the ABCI (injuries) after each major move of the patient.
questions.explanationZh: 装载与转运环节要求在每次大幅移动患者后重新评估 ABCI（气道、呼吸、循环及损伤）。

questions.questionEn: A 35-year-old ejected driver has absent radial pulses and decreased LOC. You have completed the primary survey and survey interventions. What is the best next course of action?
questions.questionZh: 一名 35 岁被甩出车外的司机桡动脉搏动消失、意识下降。你已完成初步检查和检查干预措施。下一步最佳做法是什么？

options.en: Complete a full secondary survey on scene before moving him
options.zh: 在现场完成全部再次检查后再移动他

options.en: Wait on scene for vital signs to improve
options.zh: 在现场等待生命体征改善

options.en: Initiate transport now and continue the assessment en route
options.zh: 立即开始转运，途中继续评估

options.en: Perform a detailed functional inquiry first
options.zh: 先进行详细的系统功能问诊

questions.explanationEn: Depending on patient condition, load and transport may be appropriate any time after the decision point. This patient is unstable, so transport should not be delayed for a full on-scene secondary survey.
questions.explanationZh: 根据患者情况，装载与转运可在“决定点”之后的任何时机进行。该患者不稳定，不应为在现场完成全部再次检查而延误转运。

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old woman has sudden facial droop and slurred speech that started 30 minutes ago. Her airway is clear and vitals are within normal limits. How should you manage the call?
questions.questionZh: 一名 76 岁女性 30 分钟前突发口角歪斜、言语含糊。气道通畅，生命体征在正常范围。你应如何处理？

options.en: Treat her as unstable and initiate prompt transport
options.zh: 按不稳定患者处理并尽快转运

options.en: Treat her as stable because her vital signs are normal
options.zh: 因生命体征正常而按稳定患者处理

options.en: Advise her to see her family doctor tomorrow
options.zh: 建议她明天去看家庭医生

options.en: Remain on scene until symptoms resolve
options.zh: 留在现场直到症状缓解

questions.explanationEn: Suspected CVA is on the list of primary survey findings that categorize a patient as unstable, even when vital signs are currently normal. Prompt transport is required.
questions.explanationZh: 疑似脑血管意外（CVA）属于初步检查判定不稳定的表现之一，即使当前生命体征正常也应按不稳定处理并尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: An 8-month-old pulled a cup of hot tea off a table and has scald burns across her face and mouth. She is crying loudly. How should you categorize and manage her?
questions.questionZh: 一名 8 个月大的婴儿把一杯热茶从桌上拉倒，面部和口周被烫伤，正在大声哭闹。你应如何判定并处置？

options.en: Stable — loud crying proves the airway is fine, so treat on scene
options.zh: 稳定——大声哭闹证明气道无碍，可在现场处理

options.en: Stable — facial burns are only cosmetic concerns
options.zh: 稳定——面部烧伤只是外观问题

options.en: Unstable — facial burns are a major burn criterion with airway risk; transport appropriately
options.zh: 不稳定——面部烧伤属重度烧伤标准且有气道风险，应及时转运

options.en: Only transport if blisters form
options.zh: 仅在出现水疱时才转运

questions.explanationEn: Facial or airway burns, with or without inhalation injury, are listed under major burns that make a patient unstable. Airway swelling can develop after the initial assessment.
questions.explanationZh: 无论是否合并吸入性损伤，面部或气道烧伤都属于判定不稳定的重度烧伤标准。气道肿胀可能在初次评估后才出现。

questions.questionEn: Which question is part of the critical history for a motor vehicle accident?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪个问题属于机动车事故（MVA）关键病史的内容？

options.en: What did the patient eat for breakfast?
options.zh: 患者早餐吃了什么？

options.en: Were the vehicle's airbags deployed?
options.zh: 车辆的安全气囊是否弹出？

options.en: Does the patient have travel insurance?
options.zh: 患者是否购买了旅行保险？

options.en: What colour was the traffic light?
options.zh: 当时交通灯是什么颜色？

questions.explanationEn: MVA critical history includes impact speed, damage, restraints, patient position, loss of consciousness, condition of other patients, and whether airbags were deployed.
questions.explanationZh: 机动车事故关键病史包括撞击速度、车辆损坏、约束装置、患者位置、意识丧失、其他伤员情况以及安全气囊是否弹出。

questions.questionEn: A construction worker fell from scaffolding. Which critical history question specifically addresses the nature of his descent?
questions.questionZh: 一名建筑工人从脚手架上坠落。哪个关键病史问题专门针对其坠落过程的性质？

options.en: Did he eat lunch before the fall?
options.zh: 坠落前他是否吃过午饭？

options.en: How many years has he worked construction?
options.zh: 他从事建筑工作多少年？

options.en: Was his harness inspected this month?
options.zh: 他的安全带本月是否检查过？

options.en: Was it a free fall, or did he hit other objects on the way down?
options.zh: 是自由坠落，还是下落过程中撞到了其他物体？

questions.explanationEn: Fall history includes: where from, height, free fall or striking objects during the fall, landing surface, what hit first, movement since, LOC, and cause of the fall.
questions.explanationZh: 坠落病史包括：从何处坠落、高度、是否自由坠落或途中撞击物体、着地表面、身体哪个部位先着地、事后是否移动、有无意识丧失及坠落原因。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old woman fell in her bathroom. Which detail is a listed critical history question for falls?
questions.questionZh: 一名 78 岁女性在浴室跌倒。下列哪项细节属于坠落/跌倒关键病史所列的问题？

options.en: The brand of her bathroom fixtures
options.zh: 浴室设备的品牌

options.en: Whether her home has stairs
options.zh: 她家中是否有楼梯

options.en: Her preferred hospital
options.zh: 她希望送往哪家医院

options.en: The type of surface she landed on
options.zh: 她跌倒时着地的表面类型

questions.explanationEn: The landing surface is a listed critical history question for falls because it influences the energy transferred and likely injuries.
questions.explanationZh: 着地表面是跌倒关键病史所列问题之一，因为它影响能量传递和可能的损伤类型。

questions.questionEn: A pedestrian was hit by a pickup truck. Which critical history detail helps estimate the energy involved in the impact?
questions.questionZh: 一名行人被皮卡车撞倒。哪项关键病史细节有助于估计撞击涉及的能量？

options.en: The truck driver's age
options.zh: 皮卡司机的年龄

options.en: The distance the patient was thrown
options.zh: 患者被撞飞的距离

options.en: The truck's licence plate number
options.zh: 皮卡的车牌号码

options.en: The pedestrian's occupation
options.zh: 行人的职业

questions.explanationEn: Pedestrian-struck critical history includes vehicle size and velocity, what part of the vehicle hit what part of the patient, vehicle damage, and the distance the patient was thrown.
questions.explanationZh: 行人被撞的关键病史包括车辆大小与速度、车辆哪个部位撞击患者哪个部位、车辆损坏情况以及患者被撞飞的距离。

questions.questionEn: For a stabbing, which weapon detail is part of the critical history?
questions.questionZh: 对于刺伤事件，哪项凶器细节属于关键病史内容？

options.en: The weapon's purchase price
options.zh: 凶器的购买价格

options.en: The weapon's country of manufacture
options.zh: 凶器的制造国

options.en: The length and width of the weapon
options.zh: 凶器的长度和宽度

options.en: The colour of the handle
options.zh: 刀柄的颜色

questions.explanationEn: Stabbing critical history includes the type of weapon, its size (length and width), slashed versus stabbed wounds, number of wounds, other injuries, initial position, and LOC.
questions.explanationZh: 刺伤关键病史包括凶器类型、尺寸（长度和宽度）、划伤还是刺伤、伤口数量、其他损伤、初始体位及意识丧失情况。

questions.questionEn: You are called to a shooting. Which critical history question is most relevant to predicting wound severity?
questions.questionZh: 你被派往一起枪击现场。哪个关键病史问题与预测伤情严重程度最相关？

options.en: The range from which the shot was fired
options.zh: 开枪时的射击距离

options.en: Who owns the firearm
options.zh: 枪支的所有人是谁

options.en: Whether the firearm was legally registered
options.zh: 枪支是否合法登记

options.en: The time the firearm was purchased
options.zh: 枪支购买的时间

questions.explanationEn: Shooting critical history includes the type of firearm, range, angle of shot, type of bullet if possible, and entrance and exit wounds — all of which affect injury severity.
questions.explanationZh: 枪击关键病史包括枪支类型、射击距离、射击角度、可能时了解弹药类型以及入口和出口伤——这些都影响伤情严重程度。

questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old man is found on his kitchen floor after a fall with a small scalp laceration. Beyond the injuries, why is asking about the cause of the fall particularly important?
questions.questionZh: 一名 80 岁男性跌倒后被发现躺在厨房地板上，头皮有小裂伤。除损伤本身外，为什么询问跌倒原因尤其重要？

options.en: It determines whether police must attend
options.zh: 它决定是否需要警察到场

options.en: It is only needed for the billing record
options.zh: 仅为计费记录所需

options.en: A medical event such as syncope may have caused the fall and may still be evolving
options.zh: 晕厥等内科事件可能是跌倒的原因，且可能仍在进展

options.en: It tells you which splint to apply
options.zh: 它决定应使用哪种夹板

questions.explanationEn: The cause of the fall is a listed critical history question. In older adults a fall may be the result of an underlying medical emergency, not just its cause of injury.
questions.explanationZh: 跌倒原因是关键病史所列问题之一。老年人跌倒可能由潜在的内科急症引起，而不仅仅是外伤问题。

questions.questionEn: A 7-year-old was struck by an SUV in a school zone. Which critical history question helps you predict the pattern of injuries?
questions.questionZh: 一名 7 岁儿童在学校区域被 SUV 撞倒。哪个关键病史问题有助于预测损伤分布？

options.en: What part of the vehicle hit what part of the patient?
options.zh: 车辆哪个部位撞到了患者身体哪个部位？

options.en: Whether the driver was late for work
options.zh: 司机是否上班迟到

options.en: The child's grade in school
options.zh: 孩子上几年级

options.en: Whether the SUV had winter tires
options.zh: SUV 是否装了冬季轮胎

questions.explanationEn: Pedestrian-struck critical history specifically asks what part of the vehicle hit what part of the patient, which predicts injury pattern, alongside speed, damage, and distance thrown.
questions.explanationZh: 行人被撞关键病史专门询问车辆哪个部位撞击患者身体哪个部位，结合车速、车损和撞飞距离可预测损伤分布。

questions.questionEn: On the AVPU scale, what does a rating of "V" indicate?
questions.questionZh: 在 AVPU 意识评估中，评级为 V 表示什么？

options.en: The patient is awake, talking, and fully oriented
options.zh: 患者清醒、能交谈且定向力完好

options.en: The patient responds only to painful stimuli
options.zh: 患者仅对疼痛刺激有反应

options.en: The patient has no response to any stimuli
options.zh: 患者对任何刺激均无反应

options.en: The patient responds to verbal stimulus but is drowsy
options.zh: 患者对言语刺激有反应但昏昏欲睡

questions.explanationEn: V (Verbal) means the patient responds to verbal stimulus but is drowsy; consider placing the patient semi-prone if injuries permit.
questions.explanationZh: V（言语）表示患者对言语刺激有反应但嗜睡；如损伤允许，可考虑将其置于半俯卧位。

questions.questionEn: A 40-year-old overdose patient does not respond to loud verbal commands but groans and withdraws when you pinch his trapezius. How do you classify him, and what position should he be in?
questions.questionZh: 一名 40 岁药物过量患者对大声言语指令无反应，但在捏斜方肌时呻吟并回缩。应如何分级？应采取什么体位？

options.en: V — keep him supine at all times
options.zh: V——始终保持仰卧位

options.en: P — place him semi-prone if injuries permit and monitor the airway closely
options.zh: P——如损伤允许置于半俯卧位，并密切监测气道

options.en: A — no airway concerns exist
options.zh: A——不存在气道问题

options.en: U — begin ventilations immediately
options.zh: U——立即开始人工通气

questions.explanationEn: Responding only to painful stimuli is a P rating. These patients should be semi-prone, injuries permitting, with close airway monitoring and intervention as necessary.
questions.explanationZh: 仅对疼痛刺激有反应属于 P 级。在损伤允许的情况下应置于半俯卧位，密切监测气道并按需干预。

questions.questionEn: An 84-year-old woman opens her eyes and answers questions when you speak loudly to her, but drifts back to sleep when you stop. What is her AVPU rating?
questions.questionZh: 一名 84 岁女性在你大声对她说话时会睁眼并回答问题，但你一停下她又昏睡过去。她的 AVPU 评级是什么？

options.en: A — Alert
options.zh: A——清醒

options.en: V — responds to verbal stimulus but is drowsy
options.zh: V——对言语刺激有反应但嗜睡

options.en: P — responds to pain
options.zh: P——对疼痛有反应

options.en: U — Unresponsive
options.zh: U——无反应

questions.explanationEn: She is not spontaneously alert but responds to verbal stimulus and is drowsy, which is the definition of V on the AVPU scale.
questions.explanationZh: 她并非自发清醒，而是对言语刺激有反应且嗜睡，符合 AVPU 中 V 级的定义。

questions.questionEn: According to the AVPU descriptions, what is the key airway implication for a patient rated "U"?
questions.questionZh: 根据 AVPU 的描述，评级为 U 的患者在气道方面的关键意义是什么？

options.en: The airway is secure as long as the patient is supine
options.zh: 只要患者仰卧，气道就是安全的

options.en: The airway only needs monitoring if vomiting occurs
options.zh: 只有呕吐时才需要监测气道

options.en: The patient can protect their own airway
options.zh: 患者能够保护自己的气道

options.en: The patient cannot protect their own airway; you must intervene and monitor very closely
options.zh: 患者无法保护自身气道，你必须干预并极密切地监测

questions.explanationEn: A U-rated patient has no response to stimuli and is unable to protect their own airway; the attendant must intervene and very closely monitor the airway.
questions.explanationZh: U 级患者对刺激无反应，无法保护自身气道；施救者必须进行干预并非常密切地监测气道。

questions.questionEn: A 4-year-old post-seizure responds only when you press firmly on her nail bed, moaning and pulling away. What does this AVPU rating require of you?
questions.questionZh: 一名 4 岁癫痫发作后的患儿仅在用力按压甲床时才呻吟并回缩。这一 AVPU 评级要求你做什么？

options.en: Rate her P; monitor the airway closely, intervene as necessary, and position semi-prone if injuries permit
options.zh: 评为 P 级；密切监测气道、按需干预，如损伤允许置于半俯卧位

options.en: Rate her V and allow her parents to hold her upright
options.zh: 评为 V 级并让家长竖抱她

options.en: Rate her A because she reacts to touch
options.zh: 因对触碰有反应而评为 A 级

options.en: Rate her U and begin CPR
options.zh: 评为 U 级并开始心肺复苏

questions.explanationEn: Response only to painful stimulus is a P rating, which requires close airway monitoring, intervention as necessary, and semi-prone positioning where injuries permit.
questions.explanationZh: 仅对疼痛刺激有反应为 P 级，要求密切监测气道、必要时干预，并在损伤允许时采用半俯卧位。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old man with a c-spine concern is fully alert but immobilized supine and complaining of worsening nausea. Per the AVPU notes, what should you anticipate?
questions.questionZh: 一名有颈椎损伤顾虑的 72 岁男性完全清醒，但被仰卧位固定且主诉恶心加重。根据 AVPU 的说明，你应预见什么？

options.en: Nothing — an Alert patient never needs airway help
options.zh: 无需任何准备——清醒患者绝不需要气道协助

options.en: He should be told to swallow any vomitus
options.zh: 应嘱其将呕吐物咽下

options.en: Even an Alert patient may need airway help when there is a c-spine concern with nausea or an oral bleed
options.zh: 即使是清醒患者，在有颈椎顾虑且伴恶心或口腔出血时也可能需要气道协助

options.en: His rating must be changed to P
options.zh: 应将其评级改为 P

questions.explanationEn: The AVPU description of Alert notes the patient should maintain their own airway but may need help if there is a c-spine concern and they are nauseated or bleeding orally.
questions.explanationZh: AVPU 对 A 级的说明指出：清醒患者通常能维持自身气道，但若存在颈椎顾虑且伴恶心或口腔出血，可能需要协助。

questions.questionEn: In the Patient Assessment Model, when is the baseline set of vital signs obtained?
questions.questionZh: 在患者评估模型中，基线生命体征应在什么阶段测量？

options.en: During the secondary survey
options.zh: 在再次检查期间

options.en: During the rescue scene evaluation
options.zh: 在救援现场评估期间

options.en: Only after arrival at hospital
options.zh: 到达医院后才测量

options.en: Before assessing the airway
options.zh: 在评估气道之前

questions.explanationEn: The secondary survey consists of history, vital signs, and the head-to-toe examination; its purpose includes establishing a baseline set of vital signs.
questions.explanationZh: 再次检查包括病史、生命体征和从头到脚检查，其目的之一就是建立基线生命体征。

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old man with an isolated ankle fracture is in severe pain and you are considering Entonox. Before he uses it, what must you have obtained?
questions.questionZh: 一名 79 岁男性单纯踝部骨折、疼痛剧烈，你考虑给予安桃乐（Entonox）。在他使用之前，你必须先获得什么？

options.en: A 12-lead ECG
options.zh: 12 导联心电图

options.en: Written consent from his family
options.zh: 家属的书面同意

options.en: A baseline set of vital signs, including oxygen saturation
options.zh: 基线生命体征，包括血氧饱和度

options.en: A blood glucose reading
options.zh: 血糖读数

questions.explanationEn: Before using Entonox you must complete a primary survey, investigate the pain, obtain baseline vital signs including oxygen saturation, and rule out contraindications.
questions.explanationZh: 使用安桃乐前必须完成初步检查、了解疼痛情况、获取包括血氧饱和度在内的基线生命体征，并排除禁忌证。

questions.questionEn: You are treating a 58-year-old with cardiac chest pain and administering Nitroglycerin. How often should vital signs be reassessed during ongoing treatment?
questions.questionZh: 你正在处理一名 58 岁心源性胸痛患者并给予硝酸甘油。持续治疗期间应多久复测一次生命体征？

options.en: Every 30 minutes
options.zh: 每 30 分钟一次

options.en: Every 5 minutes
options.zh: 每 5 分钟一次

options.en: Only after each medication dose
options.zh: 仅在每次给药后

options.en: Once at the start and once at hospital
options.zh: 开始时一次、到院时一次

questions.explanationEn: The cardiac chest pain guideline directs continuing assessment, treatment, and vital signs every 5 minutes during the protocol.
questions.explanationZh: 心源性胸痛指南要求在执行协议期间持续评估与治疗，并每 5 分钟复测生命体征。

questions.questionEn: Which artery should be used to assess the pulse of an infant?
questions.questionZh: 评估婴儿脉搏应使用哪条动脉？

options.en: Carotid
options.zh: 颈动脉

options.en: Radial
options.zh: 桡动脉

options.en: Femoral only
options.zh: 仅用股动脉

options.en: Brachial
options.zh: 肱动脉

questions.explanationEn: In infants, assess for a pulse using the brachial artery rather than the carotid, which is difficult to isolate in an infant's short neck.
questions.explanationZh: 婴儿应触摸肱动脉而非颈动脉评估脉搏，因为婴儿颈部短，颈动脉不易定位。

questions.questionEn: In the Patient Assessment Model, what are the two elements of the Records and Reports component?
questions.questionZh: 在患者评估模型中，“记录与报告”环节包含哪两个要素？

options.en: Vital signs and functional inquiry
options.zh: 生命体征与系统功能问诊

options.en: Billing and scheduling
options.zh: 计费与排班

options.en: Radio report and equipment check
options.zh: 无线电报告与设备检查

options.en: Hand-off report and documentation
options.zh: 交接报告与书面记录

questions.explanationEn: The Records and Reports component consists of the hand-off report and documentation; reports gather or give information about the patient's status and treatment.
questions.explanationZh: “记录与报告”环节由交接报告和书面记录组成；报告用于收集或传递患者状态与治疗信息。

questions.questionEn: According to the assessment model, what is the purpose of patient care forms such as the PCR?
questions.questionZh: 根据评估模型，患者护理报告（PCR）等表格的用途是什么？

options.en: To replace the verbal hand-off report
options.zh: 取代口头交接报告

options.en: To record the assessment and treatment of a patient
options.zh: 记录对患者的评估与治疗

options.en: To assign blame after adverse events
options.zh: 在不良事件后追责

options.en: To provide dispatch statistics only
options.zh: 仅用于调度统计

questions.explanationEn: Forms are used to record the assessment and treatment of a patient, while reports are used to gather or give information regarding the patient's status and treatment.
questions.explanationZh: 表格用于记录对患者的评估与治疗，而报告用于收集或传递有关患者状态和治疗的信息。

questions.questionEn: You arrive at the emergency department with a trauma patient. What is the primary purpose of your verbal hand-off report to the receiving staff?
questions.questionZh: 你将一名创伤患者送达急诊科。向接收人员进行口头交接报告的主要目的是什么？

options.en: To document your mileage and response times
options.zh: 记录行车里程和反应时间

options.en: To request feedback on your driving
options.zh: 征求对你驾驶水平的反馈

options.en: To give information regarding the patient's status and the treatment provided
options.zh: 传递患者状态及已提供治疗的信息

options.en: To transfer legal liability to the hospital
options.zh: 将法律责任转移给医院

questions.explanationEn: Reports are used to gather or give information regarding the patient's status and treatment; the hand-off report ensures continuity of care at transfer.
questions.explanationZh: 报告用于收集或传递患者状态与治疗信息；交接报告确保转交时护理的连续性。

questions.questionEn: A crew's PCR reads: "82♀ c/o CP, Hx MI, NKA." How do you interpret this entry?
questions.questionZh: 某车组的 PCR 写道：“82♀ c/o CP, Hx MI, NKA。”你应如何解读这条记录？

options.en: An 82-year-old female complains of chest pain, has a history of myocardial infarction, and has no known allergies
options.zh: 82 岁女性主诉胸痛，有心肌梗死病史，无已知过敏

options.en: An 82-year-old female with chest palpitations, hip malalignment, and no kin available
options.zh: 82 岁女性心悸、髋关节错位、无亲属可联系

options.en: An 82-year-old male with cough and pneumonia, taking multiple medications
options.zh: 82 岁男性咳嗽伴肺炎，服用多种药物

options.en: An 82-year-old female with chronic pain and a new kidney ailment
options.zh: 82 岁女性慢性疼痛并新发肾病

questions.explanationEn: Per the approved abbreviations: c/o = complains of, CP = chest pain, Hx = history, MI = myocardial infarction, NKA = no known allergies.
questions.explanationZh: 按官方缩写表：c/o=主诉，CP=胸痛，Hx=病史，MI=心肌梗死，NKA=无已知过敏。

questions.questionEn: On a patient care report, what does the abbreviation "NPO" mean?
questions.questionZh: 在患者护理报告中，缩写 NPO 是什么意思？

options.en: No pulse obtained
options.zh: 未触及脉搏

options.en: Normal pupillary observation
options.zh: 瞳孔观察正常

options.en: Nothing by mouth
options.zh: 禁食禁饮（不经口摄入）

options.en: New patient orientation
options.zh: 新患者定向

questions.explanationEn: NPO stands for nothing by mouth in the approved abbreviation list.
questions.explanationZh: 在官方缩写表中，NPO 表示禁止经口摄入任何东西。

questions.questionEn: You document that Nitroglycerin was given "SL." What route does this abbreviation indicate?
questions.questionZh: 你记录硝酸甘油经 “SL” 途径给药。该缩写表示哪种给药途径？

options.en: Sublingual
options.zh: 舌下含服

options.en: Subcutaneous
options.zh: 皮下注射

options.en: Slow intravenous
options.zh: 缓慢静脉注射

options.en: Left side administration
options.zh: 左侧给药

questions.explanationEn: SL (or sl) is the approved abbreviation for sublingual; subcutaneous is abbreviated SC.
questions.explanationZh: SL（或 sl）是舌下给药的官方缩写；皮下注射的缩写是 SC。

questions.questionEn: What does the abbreviation "PERL" stand for in patient documentation?
questions.questionZh: 在患者记录中，缩写 PERL 代表什么？

options.en: Patient evaluated, ready to leave
options.zh: 患者已评估，可以离开

options.en: Peripheral edema, right leg
options.zh: 右下肢外周水肿

options.en: Pulse elevated, respirations low
options.zh: 脉搏增快，呼吸减慢

options.en: Pupils equal, react to light
options.zh: 双侧瞳孔等大，对光反射存在

questions.explanationEn: PERL means pupils equal, react to light. PERLA adds "and accommodation."
questions.explanationZh: PERL 表示双侧瞳孔等大且对光反射存在；PERLA 则再加上调节反射。

questions.questionEn: A 75-year-old's medication list includes "ASA od." A colleague asks if this means the patient overdosed. What is the correct interpretation?
questions.questionZh: 一名 75 岁患者的用药清单上写着 “ASA od”。同事问这是否表示患者用药过量。正确的解读是什么？

options.en: Yes — od always means overdose
options.zh: 是——od 一律表示用药过量

options.en: No — lowercase "od" means once per day; overdose is written "OD"
options.zh: 不是——小写 od 表示每日一次；用药过量写作大写 OD

options.en: No — od means taken at bedtime
options.zh: 不是——od 表示睡前服用

options.en: No — od means by mouth
options.zh: 不是——od 表示口服

questions.explanationEn: In the abbreviation list, lowercase "od" means once per day, while uppercase "OD" means overdose. The context here is a daily Aspirin dose.
questions.explanationZh: 缩写表中小写 od 表示每日一次，大写 OD 表示用药过量。此处语境是每日一次的阿司匹林。

questions.questionEn: What does the abbreviation "TIA" stand for?
questions.questionZh: 缩写 TIA 代表什么？

options.en: Total intracranial aneurysm
options.zh: 完全性颅内动脉瘤

options.en: Transient ischemic attack
options.zh: 短暂性脑缺血发作

options.en: Traumatic internal abrasion
options.zh: 创伤性内部擦伤

options.en: Thoracic injury assessment
options.zh: 胸部损伤评估

questions.explanationEn: TIA is the approved abbreviation for transient ischemic attack.
questions.explanationZh: TIA 是短暂性脑缺血发作的官方缩写。

questions.questionEn: A PCR for a 10-year-old who fell from playground bars documents "suspected R wrist #." What does the "#" symbol mean?
questions.questionZh: 一名从攀爬架跌落的 10 岁儿童的 PCR 上写着 “suspected R wrist #”。符号 “#” 表示什么？

options.en: A numbered wound
options.zh: 编号的伤口

options.en: A hospital code
options.zh: 医院代码

options.en: Hashtag — no clinical meaning
options.zh: 话题标签——无临床含义

options.en: Fracture
options.zh: 骨折

questions.explanationEn: Both "Fx" and "#" are approved abbreviations for fracture; the entry means a suspected right wrist fracture.
questions.explanationZh: “Fx” 和 “#” 都是骨折的官方缩写；该记录表示疑似右腕骨折。

questions.questionEn: A patient's inhaler is labelled "2 puffs prn." When does the patient take this medication?
questions.questionZh: 患者的吸入器标注为 “2 puffs prn”。患者应在什么时候使用该药？

options.en: As needed, when symptoms require it
options.zh: 按需使用，即症状需要时

options.en: Every morning without fail
options.zh: 每天早晨定时使用

options.en: Only before meals
options.zh: 仅在饭前使用

options.en: Four times a day on a schedule
options.zh: 每日定时四次

questions.explanationEn: "prn" is the approved abbreviation for as needed / as required.
questions.explanationZh: prn 是“按需使用/必要时使用”的官方缩写。

questions.questionEn: A transfer document for a 6-year-old asthmatic notes "↓ AE bilaterally." What assessment finding does this record?
questions.questionZh: 一名 6 岁哮喘患儿的转运文书上写着 “↓ AE bilaterally”。这记录的是什么评估发现？

options.en: Decreased ankle edema on both sides
options.zh: 双侧踝部水肿减轻

options.en: Diminished alertness and energy
options.zh: 警觉性和精力下降

options.en: Decreased air entry on both sides of the chest
options.zh: 双侧胸部呼吸音（进气量）减弱

options.en: Delayed arrival estimate, both crews
options.zh: 两个车组均预计延迟到达

questions.explanationEn: The down arrow means diminished/decreased and AE (A/E) means air entry, so the note documents decreased air entry bilaterally — a significant finding in asthma.
questions.explanationZh: 下箭头表示减弱/降低，AE（A/E）表示进气量/呼吸音，因此该记录为双侧呼吸音减弱——哮喘中的重要体征。

questions.questionEn: When determining whether an adult is in cardiac arrest, how should breathing and pulse be assessed?
questions.questionZh: 判断成人是否发生心搏骤停时，应如何评估呼吸和脉搏？

options.en: Simultaneously, taking no more than 10 seconds
options.zh: 同时进行，不超过 10 秒

options.en: Breathing first for 15 seconds, then pulse for 15 seconds
options.zh: 先评估呼吸 15 秒，再评估脉搏 15 秒

options.en: Pulse only — breathing is irrelevant
options.zh: 只查脉搏——呼吸无关紧要

options.en: Over a full minute to be accurate
options.zh: 用整整一分钟以确保准确

questions.explanationEn: Assess breathing and check the pulse simultaneously for no more than 10 seconds. If there is no pulse, no breathing, or gasping breathing, begin CPR.
questions.explanationZh: 应同时评估呼吸并触摸脉搏，时间不超过 10 秒。若无脉搏、无呼吸或仅有喘息样呼吸，即开始心肺复苏。

questions.questionEn: A collapsed 50-year-old man has no palpable pulse but takes occasional gasping breaths. What do these findings indicate?
questions.questionZh: 一名倒地的 50 岁男性触不到脉搏，但偶有喘息样呼吸。这些表现说明什么？

options.en: He is breathing, so CPR is not indicated
options.zh: 他还有呼吸，因此不需要心肺复苏

options.en: He needs oxygen by mask and monitoring only
options.zh: 只需面罩给氧并观察

options.en: He is in cardiac arrest — gasping breathing does not count as breathing; begin CPR
options.zh: 他处于心搏骤停——喘息样呼吸不算有效呼吸，应立即开始心肺复苏

options.en: Wait 2 minutes and reassess before acting
options.zh: 等 2 分钟后再评估再行动

questions.explanationEn: No pulse with absent or gasping (agonal) breathing defines cardiac arrest; begin CPR 30:2 and apply the AED as soon as possible.
questions.explanationZh: 无脉搏且呼吸消失或呈喘息样（濒死呼吸）即为心搏骤停；应立即按 30:2 开始心肺复苏并尽快使用 AED。

questions.questionEn: What is the compression-to-ventilation ratio for adult CPR?
questions.questionZh: 成人心肺复苏的按压与通气比是多少？

options.en: 15:2 with two rescuers
options.zh: 双人施救时为 15:2

options.en: 30:2, whether there are one or two rescuers
options.zh: 无论单人还是双人施救均为 30:2

options.en: 5:1 at all times
options.zh: 始终为 5:1

options.en: 3:1 with two rescuers
options.zh: 双人施救时为 3:1

questions.explanationEn: For adults the ratio is 30:2 for both one and two rescuers. The 15:2 two-rescuer ratio applies to infants and children.
questions.explanationZh: 成人无论单人或双人施救比例均为 30:2。15:2 的双人比例适用于婴儿和儿童。

questions.questionEn: What is the optimum chest compression rate during CPR?
questions.questionZh: 心肺复苏时最佳的胸外按压频率是多少？

options.en: 60-80 per minute
options.zh: 每分钟 60-80 次

options.en: 80-100 per minute
options.zh: 每分钟 80-100 次

options.en: At least 140 per minute
options.zh: 每分钟至少 140 次

options.en: 100-120 per minute

questions.explanationEn: The optimum compression rate is 100-120 per minute for adults, children, and infants.
questions.explanationZh: 无论成人、儿童还是婴儿，最佳按压频率均为每分钟 100-120 次。

questions.questionEn: What is the target compression depth for a normal-sized adult?
questions.questionZh: 对体型正常的成人，胸外按压的目标深度是多少？

options.en: 2.0 to 3.0 cm
3.0 to 4.0 cm
At least 8.0 cm
options.zh: 至少 8.0 厘米

options.en: 5.0 to 6.0 cm

questions.explanationEn: Compress 5.0 to 6.0 cm in a normal adult, adjusting to 1/3 to 1/2 of chest diameter for smaller or bigger patients, with complete recoil after each compression.
questions.explanationZh: 正常成人按压深度为 5.0-6.0 厘米，体型偏小或偏大者调整为胸廓前后径的 1/3 至 1/2，每次按压后应让胸廓完全回弹。

questions.questionEn: You are doing compressions on a 74-year-old in cardiac arrest when your partner arrives with the AED. When should the AED be applied and used?
questions.questionZh: 你正在为一名 74 岁心搏骤停患者做按压，搭档带着 AED 赶到。应在何时贴放并使用 AED？

options.en: After 10 minutes of CPR have been completed
options.zh: 完成 10 分钟心肺复苏之后

options.en: As soon as possible — position it and analyze without delay
options.zh: 越快越好——立即贴放电极并分析心律

options.en: Only if the patient does not respond to 4 cycles of CPR
options.zh: 仅当 4 个循环的心肺复苏无效时

options.en: Only after paramedics arrive
options.zh: 必须等护理人员（paramedic）到达后

questions.explanationEn: Early defibrillation is essential: position the AED and analyze as soon as possible. Early CPR and early defibrillation should coexist without one impeding the other.
questions.explanationZh: 早期除颤至关重要：应尽快贴放 AED 并分析心律。早期心肺复苏与早期除颤应同时兼顾，互不妨碍。

questions.questionEn: The AED advises a shock on an adult in cardiac arrest. What is the correct sequence after delivering the shock?
questions.questionZh: AED 提示对一名成人心搏骤停患者进行电击。电击后正确的操作顺序是什么？

options.en: Check the pulse for 30 seconds, then resume CPR if absent
options.zh: 先测脉搏 30 秒，无脉搏再恢复按压

options.en: Analyze again immediately, shocking repeatedly until ROSC
options.zh: 立即再次分析，反复电击直至自主循环恢复

options.en: Resume CPR immediately for 2 minutes, then analyze again
options.zh: 立即恢复心肺复苏 2 分钟，然后再次分析

options.en: Ventilate for 1 minute before resuming compressions
options.zh: 先通气 1 分钟再恢复按压

questions.explanationEn: Single shocks are followed immediately by 2 minutes of CPR, then re-analysis. CPR also continues during the charging phase.
questions.explanationZh: 单次电击后应立即进行 2 分钟心肺复苏，然后再次分析；充电期间也应继续按压。

questions.questionEn: The AED on a 70-year-old arrest patient announces "no shock advised." What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 70 岁心搏骤停患者的 AED 提示“不建议电击”。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Resume CPR immediately for 2 minutes, then analyze again
options.zh: 立即恢复心肺复苏 2 分钟，然后再次分析

options.en: Stop resuscitation — no shock means the patient cannot survive
options.zh: 终止复苏——不建议电击意味着患者无法存活

options.en: Remove the pads and reposition them before reanalyzing
options.zh: 先取下电极片重新贴放再分析

options.en: Deliver a manual precordial thump
options.zh: 进行心前区叩击

questions.explanationEn: When no shock is advised, resume CPR immediately, continue for 2 minutes, analyze, and repeat the cycle.
questions.explanationZh: 当提示不建议电击时，应立即恢复心肺复苏，持续 2 分钟后再分析，并重复该循环。

questions.questionEn: You find an 88-year-old woman in cardiac arrest at a care facility. Staff present you with a valid, verifiable Do Not Resuscitate order. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 你在护理机构发现一名 88 岁女性心搏骤停。工作人员出示了一份有效且可核实的“不施行心肺复苏”（DNR）医嘱。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Begin CPR anyway until a physician arrives
options.zh: 仍然开始心肺复苏，直到医生到场

options.en: Perform compressions but withhold ventilations
options.zh: 只做按压，不做通气

options.en: Do not initiate CPR — a verifiable DNR is a contraindication to CPR/AED
options.zh: 不启动心肺复苏——可核实的 DNR 是 CPR/AED 的禁忌证

options.en: Apply the AED but do not press the shock button
options.zh: 贴放 AED 但不按电击键

questions.explanationEn: A verifiable Do Not Resuscitate or No CPR order is the listed contraindication to CPR/AED.
questions.explanationZh: 可核实的 DNR 或“不做 CPR”医嘱是 CPR/AED 的禁忌证。

questions.questionEn: You have resuscitated a 79-year-old for 30 minutes with continuous CPR. There has been no ROSC at any point and the AED has never advised a shock. What does the guideline permit?
questions.questionZh: 你已对一名 79 岁患者持续心肺复苏 30 分钟，全程无自主循环恢复（ROSC），AED 从未建议电击。指南允许怎么做？

options.en: Resuscitation may be discontinued — 30 minutes with no ROSC and no defibrillations meets the stop criteria
options.zh: 可以终止复苏——30 分钟无 ROSC 且从未除颤符合终止标准

options.en: CPR must always continue for a minimum of 60 minutes
options.zh: 心肺复苏必须至少持续 60 分钟

options.en: CPR may only stop once the patient reaches hospital
options.zh: 只有到达医院后才能停止心肺复苏

options.en: CPR should have been stopped at 10 minutes
options.zh: 应在 10 分钟时就停止心肺复苏

questions.explanationEn: CPR/AED continues until care is transferred, signs of life appear, or 30 minutes have elapsed with no ROSC and no defibrillations. Consult medical oversight to discontinue an arrest at scene.
questions.explanationZh: CPR/AED 应持续至移交、出现生命迹象，或 30 分钟内无 ROSC 且未曾除颤。现场终止复苏需咨询医疗监督。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old arrested 32 minutes ago. The AED delivered two shocks early on, but there has been no ROSC. Your partner suggests stopping at the 30-minute mark. What is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 68 岁患者 32 分钟前心搏骤停。AED 早期给予了两次电击，但一直没有 ROSC。搭档建议在 30 分钟时停止。正确的做法是什么？

options.en: Stop now — 30 minutes applies to every arrest
options.zh: 现在就停——30 分钟适用于所有骤停

options.en: Stop only if the family agrees
options.zh: 仅在家属同意时停止

options.en: CPR should have stopped after the second shock
options.zh: 第二次电击后就应停止心肺复苏

options.en: Continue — because defibrillations were delivered, efforts continue to 40 minutes
options.zh: 继续——因为曾实施除颤，复苏应持续到 40 分钟

questions.explanationEn: The 30-minute stop point applies only when there has been no ROSC and no defibrillations. If ROSC occurred at any time or shocks were delivered, continue to 40 minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 30 分钟的终止标准仅适用于全程无 ROSC 且未除颤的情况。若曾出现 ROSC 或实施过除颤，应持续复苏至 40 分钟。

questions.questionEn: According to the CPR basic concepts, interruptions in chest compressions should be kept to less than how many seconds?
questions.questionZh: 根据心肺复苏基本原则，胸外按压的中断时间应控制在多少秒以内？

options.en: 15 seconds
5 seconds
options.zh: 5 秒

options.en: 30 seconds
20 seconds

questions.explanationEn: CPR should be provided with as few interruptions as possible, keeping interruptions to less than 5 seconds. (The initial simultaneous pulse/breathing check may take up to 10 seconds.)
questions.explanationZh: 心肺复苏应尽量减少中断，中断时间须少于 5 秒。（最初同时评估呼吸与脉搏可用最多 10 秒。）

questions.questionEn: To maintain maximum compression efficiency during a prolonged resuscitation, how often should compressor roles be changed where possible?
questions.questionZh: 在较长时间的复苏中，为保持最大按压效率，条件允许时应多久轮换一次按压者？

options.en: Every 10 minutes
options.zh: 每 10 分钟

options.en: Every 2 minutes
options.zh: 每 2 分钟

options.en: Only when the compressor reports fatigue
options.zh: 仅当按压者自述疲劳时

options.en: After every 5 shocks
options.zh: 每 5 次电击后

questions.explanationEn: Change operators every 2 minutes where possible to maintain maximum efficiency — conveniently timed with the AED analysis cycles.
questions.explanationZh: 条件允许时每 2 分钟轮换按压者以保持最大效率——正好与 AED 的分析周期同步。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old was pulled from a frozen lake in cardiac arrest and is severely hypothermic. Regarding intra-arrest transport with ongoing CPR, what does the guideline say?
questions.questionZh: 一名 68 岁患者从冰湖中被救出时已心搏骤停，伴重度低体温。关于持续 CPR 下的转运，指南怎么说？

options.en: Never move a patient during CPR under any circumstances
options.zh: 任何情况下都绝不能在 CPR 期间移动患者

options.en: Transport is only for patients who regain a pulse
options.zh: 只有恢复脉搏的患者才能转运

options.en: CPR quality does not change during transport
options.zh: 转运过程中 CPR 质量不会改变

options.en: Hypothermic arrest is one of the situations where intra-arrest transport with ongoing CPR may occur
options.zh: 低体温性骤停属于可在持续 CPR 下进行转运的情形之一

questions.explanationEn: CPR is more effective while stationary, but intra-arrest transport with ongoing CPR may occur for paediatric, hypothermic, traumatic, or treatable-cause arrests.
questions.explanationZh: 静止状态下 CPR 更有效，但对儿科、低体温、创伤性或存在可逆病因的骤停，可在持续 CPR 下进行转运。

questions.questionEn: During a cardiac arrest resuscitation, when is an EMR crew specifically directed to consult with medical oversight?
questions.questionZh: 在心搏骤停复苏过程中，EMR 车组在什么情况下被明确要求咨询医疗监督（medical oversight）？

options.en: When considering discontinuing the arrest at the scene
options.zh: 考虑在现场终止复苏时

options.en: Before applying the AED
options.zh: 贴放 AED 之前

options.en: Before every defibrillation
options.zh: 每次除颤之前

options.en: Before starting compressions
options.zh: 开始按压之前

questions.explanationEn: The guideline lists one consultation point during cardiac arrest: to discontinue the arrest at the scene.
questions.explanationZh: 指南在心搏骤停中列出的咨询时机只有一个：在现场终止复苏时。

questions.questionEn: You are alone with an AED when you find a 30-year-old in cardiac arrest from an apparent opioid overdose (asphyxia arrest). How should you sequence CPR and the AED?
questions.questionZh: 你独自一人携带 AED，发现一名 30 岁疑似阿片类药物过量（窒息性骤停）的心搏骤停患者。应如何安排 CPR 与 AED 的先后？

options.en: Apply the AED first and analyze before any CPR
options.zh: 先贴 AED 并分析，再做任何 CPR

options.en: Give naloxone first; CPR can wait
options.zh: 先给纳洛酮，CPR 可以等

options.en: Give 5 cycles (about 2 minutes) of CPR before applying the AED
options.zh: 先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR，再贴放 AED

options.en: Provide ventilations only — compressions are not needed in overdose
options.zh: 只做通气——药物过量不需要按压

questions.explanationEn: Asphyxia arrest (overdose, hanging, airway obstruction, smoke inhalation, drowning) is hypoxia-driven: if alone with an AED, give 5 cycles of CPR (about 2 minutes) before applying the AED.
questions.explanationZh: 窒息性骤停（药物过量、缢颈、气道梗阻、烟雾吸入、溺水）由缺氧引起：单人携带 AED 时，应先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR，再贴放 AED。

questions.questionEn: A 3-year-old is unresponsive with a brachial pulse of 50 per minute, mottled skin, and inadequate perfusion. What should you do?
questions.questionZh: 一名 3 岁患儿无反应，肱动脉搏动每分钟 50 次，皮肤花斑、灌注不足。你应该怎么做？

options.en: Begin CPR — a pulse below 60 with inadequate perfusion is treated as cardiac arrest in children
options.zh: 开始心肺复苏——儿童脉率低于 60 且灌注不足时按心搏骤停处理

options.en: Do not start CPR because a pulse is present
options.zh: 因为有脉搏而不开始心肺复苏

options.en: Give oxygen and reassess in 10 minutes
options.zh: 给氧并在 10 分钟后复评

options.en: Only ventilate; compressions require a completely absent pulse
options.zh: 只通气；按压必须等脉搏完全消失

questions.explanationEn: In children and infants, begin CPR when there is no pulse or when the pulse is below 60 with signs of poor perfusion.
questions.explanationZh: 对儿童和婴儿，无脉搏或脉率低于 60 且伴灌注不良表现时，应开始心肺复苏。

questions.questionEn: What are the compression-to-ventilation ratios for CPR on a 5-year-old child?
questions.questionZh: 对一名 5 岁儿童进行心肺复苏时，按压与通气比是多少？

options.en: 30:2 for both one and two rescuers
options.zh: 单人和双人施救均为 30:2

options.en: 15:2 for one rescuer, 30:2 for two rescuers
30:2 for one rescuer, 15:2 for two rescuers
3:1 regardless of rescuers
options.zh: 无论几人施救均为 3:1

questions.explanationEn: For infants and children the ratio is 30:2 with one rescuer and 15:2 with two rescuers. The 3:1 ratio is for neonates.
questions.explanationZh: 婴儿和儿童单人施救为 30:2，双人施救为 15:2；3:1 的比例用于新生儿。

questions.questionEn: You are off duty and alone, without a phone, when you find an unresponsive, pulseless 4-year-old whose collapse was not witnessed. What should you do first?
questions.questionZh: 你下班后独自一人且没带手机，发现一名无反应、无脉搏的 4 岁儿童，倒地过程无人目击。你应首先做什么？

options.en: Leave immediately to find help before touching the child
options.zh: 先离开去找人帮忙，暂不处理患儿

options.en: Perform 5 cycles (about 2 minutes) of CPR before leaving to activate the emergency response system
options.zh: 先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）心肺复苏，再去启动应急反应系统

options.en: Perform rescue breathing only for 10 minutes
options.zh: 只做人工呼吸 10 分钟

options.en: Wait with the child until someone passes by
options.zh: 守在患儿身边等人经过

questions.explanationEn: For an unwitnessed pediatric collapse when alone, immediately start CPR for 5 cycles (about 2 minutes) before activating the emergency response system and applying an AED.
questions.explanationZh: 单人遇到无人目击的儿童倒地时，应先立即做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）心肺复苏，再启动应急反应系统并获取 AED。
